items.text: 'OH WELL. CAN'T LET HERDREK HAVE ALL FUN.' THEY PICK UP THEIR CLUBS AND ATTACK.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU SEE FOUR GIANTS. 'HEY, THEM THE GUYS WHAT STEAL FROM LORD BANE. GET 'EM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU SEE FOUR GIANTS. 'THEM THE NOT BELONG HERE! GET THEM!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU ENTER A CHAMBER WHICH IS LAVISHLY APPOINTED WITH HANGINGS, CARPETS AND FURNITURE. SITTING ON A THRONE IS A POWERFUL LOOKING MAN CLAD IN BARBARIC SPLENDOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'WHAT IS YOUR BUSINESS WITH TYRANTHRAXUS, LORD OF PHLAN?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: HE SEEMS TO COLLAPSE. 'ALL RIGHT. I'M NOT TYRANTHRAXUS. HE JUST HIRED ME TO IMPERSONATE HIM. IT'S NOT A BAD LIFE, BUT, HEY! I CAN TELL WHICH WAY THE WIND'S BLOWING.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'JUST LET ME GO, OKAY?
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: HE RUNS OUT OF THE HALL. THERE IS TREASURE ALL ABOUT.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'ARROGANT KNAVE FEEL THE POWER OF TYRANTHRAXUS!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'BOY, THIS CROWN IS HEAVY. OH, WELL IT'S A LIVING. WHAT DOES TYRANTHRAXUS WAN... OOPS! GET THEM!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'BEGONE OR FEEL THE WRATH AND POWER OF TYRANTHRAXUS!' DO YOU LEAVE?
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THEN FEEL MY WRATH!
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE WOMAN SAYS 'TYRANTHRAXUS IS LEADING OUR MEN TO THEIR DEATHS. IF YOU INTEND TO KILL HIM WE WILL HELP. USE THESE CLOTHES AS A DISGUISE AND YOU WILL ESCAPE NOTICE.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WILL YOU USE THE CLOTHING AS A DISGUISE?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: AN ALARM IS SOUNDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: AN ALARM STARTS RINGING!
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHERE WOMEN ARE WASHING CLOTHES. AS YOU COME IN, THEY RETREAT TO THE CORNER LOOKING FEARFULLY AT YOU.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HEAR ONE OF THEM WHISPER, 'THEY DON'T BELONG HERE; THEY MUST HAVE COME TO KILL TYRANTHRAXUS'. A HALF-ORC WOMAN STEPS FORWARD 'WHAT DO YOU WANT OF US?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'PLEASE DON'T KILL US,' SHE SAYS. 'IF YOU DON'T WE WILL GIVE YOU THESE CLOTHES TO USE AS A DISGUISE. WE SWEAR WE WON'T SAY ANYTHING!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WELL THEN, GOOD LUCK. BEST YOU LEAVE BEFORE YOU ARE FOUND HERE.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: AMID THEIR PROTESTS YOU TIE THEM UP. THESE PROTESTS DIMINSH IN VOLUME AS YOU GAG THE WOMEN AND HIDE THEM IN A CORNER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE WOMEN SHRIEK AND FLEE BEFORE YOU AS YOU CHOP THEM DOWN. THE HALF-ORC WOMAN WITH HATE IN HER EYES SNARLS 'HEROES! HAH!' THEN HER EYES GLAZE AS SHE DIES.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: IT SEEMS THAT THEIR SCREAMS WERE HEARD...
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE SMITHY WIPES HIS BROW AND SAYS, 'NO, YOU NEVER GET TOTALLY USED TO THE HEAT, BUT IT'S NOT THAT BAD. NOW, IF YOU'LL EXCUSE ME I NEED TO GET BACK TO WORK.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WHAT? EVERYONE KNOWS THAT... HEY, YOU DON'T BELONG HERE!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'I'M SORRY, I CAN'T TAKE ANYMORE ORDERS JUST NOW. IF IT'S IMPORTANT GET AUTHORIZATION. NOW IF YOU'LL EXCUSE ME I HAVE TO GET BACK TO WORK'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: PILED UP OUT OF THE WAY ARE AN ASSORTMENT OF WEAPONS AND ARMOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ARE IN A STOREROOM FULL OF COAL.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ARE IN A STANDARD MEAT SMOKEHOUSE... WELL MAYBE NOT QUITE STANDARD. YOU FEEL A LITTLE SICK AS YOU LOOK AT THE MEAT. THE SMELL AND THE SMOKE DON'T HELP EITHER.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU ARE IN A BUILDING THAT WAS ONCE A BARRACKS BUT HAS NOW BEEN CONVERTED TO A TEMPLE OF BANE. AT THE FAR END OF THE ROOM IS A CRUDE ALTER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A PRIEST AND TWO ACOLYTES TURN FROM THE ALTER, 'WELCOME MY CHILDREN. COME FORWARD AND ACCEPT THE BLESSING OF LORD BANE.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU GO FORWARD AND KNEEL. 'IN THE NAME OF LORD BANE, GOD OF GODS, I BLESS YOU.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE PRIEST SHOUTS, 'WHAT'S THIS? YOU AREN'T WORSHIPPERS OF LORD BANE! DIE IMPOSTERS!' HE GRABS THE LAST RHINESTONE FROM A NECKLACE AND THROWS IT AT YOU. A FIREBALL EXPLODES!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THEY ATTACK YOU.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: 'I HAVE NO MORE TIME TO TALK WITH YOU, THE LORD BANE REQUIRES MY CONSTANT DEVOTION. COME, BEFORE YOU LEAVE ACCEPT THE BLESSING OF OUR LORD.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'HIS IMMENSITY, TYRANTHRAXUS, HAS SEEN FIT TO ESTABLISH THIS TEMPLE TO OUR LORD BANE. THEREFORE IT IS RIGHT THAT YOU ACCEPT THE LORD BANE'S BLESSING.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THERE IS A FEELING OF SOMETHING IMMENSE AND EVIL STARING DOWN AT YOU...
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEHIND THE ALTER ARE TWO CROSSED SWORDS. DO YOU TAKE THEM?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: 'THAT'S THEM! GET THEM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech
